objects.name: Analytic 2149
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Open Platform Communications (OPC) Unified Architecture (UA) client process on a Linux Industrial Control System (ICS) host calling browse/enumerate operations against the full namespace, from a User Identifier (UID) not associated with recognized monitoring tools. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
